# Security policy

The canonical guide is [SECURITY.adoc](../SECURITY.adoc).

Report vulnerabilities [privately through GitHub](https://github.com/hyperpolymath/rpa-elysium/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue. If that service is unavailable, email j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk. Email is not end-to-end encrypted.
